sources.snippet:
# Timeline for the Implementation of the EU AI Act
The EU's AI Act legislation applies progressively, with a full roll-out foreseen by 2 August 2027.
1. 02 Feb 2025
  General provisions (definitions & AI literacy) and prohibitions apply
2. 02 Aug 2025
  Rules for general-purpose AI apply and governance must be in place

...

3. 02 Aug 2026
The majority of rules of the AI Act come into force and enforcement starts

...

+ Rules for high-risk AI systems in Annex III enter into application **
+ Transparency rules (Article 50) start to apply
+ Measures in support of innovation start apply

sources.title: When does the AI Act go into effect? What is its timeline for implementation? | AI Act Service Desk

answer: The EU AI Act applies progressively, with full roll-out by 2 August 2028 [6]. The Act entered into force on 1 August 2024 [3]. Prohibitions, definitions and AI literacy provisions became applicable on 2 February 2025 [6]. Governance rules and general-purpose AI model obligations became applicable on 2 August 2025 [6]. Transparency requirements (Article 50) and innovation support measures apply as of 2 August 2026 [6]. Enforcement of the AI Act starts on 2 August 2026 [6]. Obligations for high-risk systems listed in Annex III enter into force on 2 December 2027 [6]. Obligations for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products, listed in Annex I, enter into force on 2 August 2028 [6].
